name.ja: 買った品が棚に戻る道

description.en: Records where a bought item comes back onto the shop's shelf. Every Item.__init__ with its id, obtainer, attributes and the game-side caller chain; the shop path boundaries (ShoppingStartManagerRemake.execute / shopping_start_method_1 / toggle_twin_inventory_window / buy_item / sell_item / close_shopping_window_process / the generators) with the keys added to and removed from both inventories; the facility's goods template with stock_tier and stock_update_date; and index['item']. Reading only
description.ja: 買った品が店の棚へ戻るのがどこかを録る。Item.__init__ ごとの id・持ち主・attributes とゲーム側の呼び出し元の連鎖、店の経路の境目（ShoppingStartManagerRemake.execute / shopping_start_method_1 / toggle_twin_inventory_window / buy_item / sell_item / close_shopping_window_process / 生成の3入口）ごとの主と手持ちの鍵の増減、施設の品揃えの雛形（goods・stock_tier・stock_update_date）、採番台帳 index['item']。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない

label.ja: 店の外で写す品の誕生の件数
label.en: New items to record outside a shop

note.ja: 店の場面の中は枠に関わらず全部写す。ロードのたびに何百も生まれるのはここで抑える
note.en: Items born during a shop scene are always recorded; this caps the rest (a load creates hundreds)

note.ja: 持ち物・採番台帳・品揃えの雛形のどれかが動いた呼び出しだけ数える。動いていない呼び出しは書かない
note.en: Only calls that moved an inventory, the id ledger or the goods template are counted

label.ja: 呼び出し元を遡る段数
label.en: How far back to walk the caller chain

note.ja: ローダと MOD のフレームは飛ばして、ゲーム側だけを数える
note.en: Loader and mod frames are skipped; only game frames are counted
